scope: copilot native user extension; new sessions; other harnesses unchanged

registration.response_rule: existing descriptor fields unchanged; additive native_extension_delivery boolean,135 binding metadata and136 daemon-resolved typing_grace_ms; native typing policy consumes the daemon value, never an independent client default
registration.identity_rule: PIJ_SESSION_ID/PIJ_SPAWN_ID when present must be corroborated as exact pre-bind/current process; manual native session+exact host process+pane resolves one stable seat; never newest-by-mtime; duplicate process mismatch refuses; same native-session reconnect retains address, user-driven new native session explicitly supersedes prior same-process seat through existing checked supersedes mechanism; mismatches otherwise refuse

claim.ownership: Copilot requires current native-extension attestation and never tmux fallback. Native CLAIM omits composer/tap admission; native extension observes actual human typing and drives136 hold/release before native.send. Explicit operator Hold and identity/target safety still veto.
claim.bound: 0 or1 claims; serialized session consumer; client handles0 by bounded wait/backoff, not failure/busy-loop
claim.incarnation_rule: Native Copilot claims require native_session/pid/proc_start equal current attested descriptor; revalidate after waits before handing off. Other harness clients keep existing request compatibility. Missing/mismatched native tuple refuses explicitly; no fallback.
claim.enforcement_layer: DeliveryService native-aware claim admission, shared by all routes. Legacy /v1/shim/inbox must refuse Copilot if it cannot supply the tuple; it must not call an unguarded claim path. No entrypoint bypass, including future direct service callers.
claim.proof_marker: Every Copilot claim row carries native_consumer equal to the tuple actually validated by daemon. Extension refuses native injection and ack if absent or mismatching; old daemon unknown-field acceptance cannot impersonate capability proof.

hold.wait_rule: Native operator/identity/target holds return promptly with zero claims even when wait=true. Normal empty inbox may long-poll; revalidate after wake. Human typing is extension-owned via136 hold/release, not a native CLAIM composer/tap gate.
hold.retry: client rate-bounded backoff (default250ms, max5000ms), abortable, no attempt ceiling; no empty-result tight loop
hold.typing_rule: Jordan ruling assets/inputs/jordan-ruling-consent-2026-09-05.md and approved sensor contract assets/inputs/pm-typing-sensor-contract-v4.json: actual injected SDK lacks pre-submit input events, so use136 pane-side observed-edit recency as sensor only. Receiver consumes daemon grace and drives /v1/hold + /v1/release; expiry admits unchanged drafts. No unavailable-sensor-as-quiet or sendkeys transport.

ack.grade: reader-read / native harness accepted, NOT model completed
ack.incarnation_rule: Copilot native ack verifies tuple against current attested descriptor AND job recipient against seat before terminal ack. Existing other-harness ack semantics retained. Delayed old consumer cannot ack replacement session work.
ack.enforcement_layer: DeliveryService derives actual running job recipient using Queue::claimed_delivery, then validates native tuple/seat before ack. Every route including shim inherits this; no bypass by naming a non-Copilot seat.

send.result: Pij receipt; no auto-forward on assistant event

rules: record Pij-to-native acceptance before daemon ack
abort old pending loop on native session shutdown/replacement
no artificial /clear or typed slash commands as product transport; isolated fixture-human lifecycle commands are separately witnessed controls

private acceptance namespace under state-dir/native-extensions/copilot hashed from stable seat/native session (process tuple is live validation and optional diagnostic metadata only); exact file layout unit-local
ambiguous or malformed claim stops affected receive work with diagnostic and no ack; outgoing tool remains usable; no new nack API

After a fresh native send, await observed completion/idle in the same generation before claiming the next message; acknowledge after acceptance separately. Subscribe before send so early idle cannot be lost. Accepted-duplicate recovery must use completion evidence or explicitly hold, not blindly send subsequent work.

Durable journal key is stable seatID + native session only; a new PID resuming that same logical native session must see earlier accepted records. Different native sessions remain isolated. Supersedes changes seat ID on user-driven new session.

commands: Body messaging only: no new native command protocol. Copilot programmatic controls explicitly unsupported at producer/caller boundary with no legacy/tmux fallback; preserve other harness controls. Native user-driven new/resume/reload is lifecycle input, not remote control.
error: non-ok or non-JSON response preserves HTTP status and raw bounded body; capability missing/refused never activates alternate transport
semantics: normal accepted duplicate suppressed; crash-after-native-accept-before-record is explicitly ambiguous until native event/history proves outcome; never falsely exactly-once

test_ownership.daemon: registry/queue/capability/consent/drain native ownership and additive wire fixtures
test_ownership.extension: native SDK state machine with protocol fixture adapter and durable acceptance record
test_ownership.installation: safe setup and real-client harness that consumes actual source/artifacts

test_isolation: Manual means no Pij identity/preallocation variables or Copilot RPC flags; PIJ_RS_ADDR and PIJ_RS_STATE_DIR endpoint-only overrides and isolated HOME/COPILOT_HOME are permitted for smoke, never the live fleet.
degraded_startup: If daemon/key unavailable or native join unsupported, ordinary Copilot session remains usable; one actionable diagnostic per failure episode, bounded abortable retry, no transcript spam or fallback. Prove isolated daemon-absent startup with native CLI.

diagnostic.sink: Copilot native session log/terminal, using documented session.log(...,{level:"info"}) or equivalent SDK-visible log; NOT a private acceptance journal
diagnostic.semantics: one actionable line per unavailability episode; no key/token values. Include failure class and retry/check-daemon advice. Suppress repeated reconnect diagnostics until a successful attach ends episode.
diagnostic.proof: unit test counts diagnostic sink calls; real CLI smoke captures isolated terminal after outage and counts this stable prefix once while ordinary nonce response succeeds; log-dir supplemental only, not assumed authoritative
diagnostic.pre_join_exception: When no joined session exists, one extension stderr diagnostic with stable prefix or native loader import error is acceptable; timeline visibility not claimed. CLI remains usable. Post-join daemon/key outage still uses native session.log.

queued_native_target: Optional daemon-private original native SESSION ID on already-attested queued recipients; same-native resume across new pid allowed, different native context explicitly held. Unstamped prebind initial task adopts first verified native session. Not a client wire change.
